While the launch of iOS 27 this month has garnered significant attention, Apple has simultaneously rolled out a new software update for AirPods. This update brings a long-awaited feature to supported AirPods models: a custom EQ.

AirPods Software Details

The latest AirPods firmware version is 9A350 (AirPods 5) and 9A348 (for the other models listed below). This update applies to the following AirPods models:

  • AirPods Pro 3
  • AirPods 4
  • AirPods 4 (Active Noise Cancellation version)
  • AirPods 5
  • AirPods 5 (Wireless Charging Case version)
  • AirPods Pro 2 (Lightning and USB-C versions)
  • AirPods Max 2

Apple states that AirPods firmware updates will install automatically when the AirPods are charging and within Bluetooth range of a connected iPhone, iPad, or Mac on Wi-Fi. You can check your AirPods firmware version in the Settings app on your iPhone.

Custom EQ Feature Arrives on AirPods

After installing the AirPods firmware update, you will see a long-awaited new feature in the Settings app: Custom EQ.

You can now take greater control of your AirPods sound through the all-new Custom EQ controls. In the Settings app, you can adjust the AirPods' bass, midrange, and treble.

Apple explains: "AirPods are designed and engineered by Apple to faithfully reproduce music, TV shows, movies, and calls as they were intended. If you prefer a different sound profile, you can customize how your AirPods present any audio playback."

While adjusting Custom EQ settings, you can play songs from Apple Music directly within the Settings app to hear the effect of your adjustments in real time.

This feature is not the most advanced equalizer on the market—it's just a basic three-band system. However, for AirPods users, it has long been anticipated and is finally here—even though most people will likely stick with the default settings.

You can find this new Custom EQ feature under the "Audio and Routing" menu for your AirPods in the Settings app. This feature applies to all AirPods equipped with the H2 chip, including AirPods Pro 2, AirPods Pro 3, AirPods 4, and AirPods Max 2.

Other New Features iOS 27 Brings to AirPods

Here are the other new features iOS 27 brings to AirPods:

  • Redesigned Settings App: In iOS 27, Apple has redesigned the AirPods interface within the Settings app. The various control options have been reorganized and separated into individual menus such as "Hearing Health," Find My, and Live Translation.
  • Adaptive Audio Slider: In the Settings app, Apple has added a slider that allows for more granular adjustment of Adaptive Audio mode.
  • GymKit: Although GymKit has been around for years, it has always required an Apple Watch to use. As my colleague Zac mentioned, iOS 27 brings the full GymKit experience to the iPhone and AirPods Pro 3.
  • Precision Finding: You can now use Precision Finding through the Find My app on your Apple Watch to locate your AirPods Pro 3.
  • Siri AI: When paired with a compatible iPhone, AirPods can interact with Siri AI.

Wrap Up

Which new AirPods feature are you most looking forward to trying? Will you give the new Custom EQ a go? Let us know in the comments section.
